verifications.claim: As of March 12, 2026, the average 30-year fixed-rate mortgage is approximately 6.11% to 6.29%.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "the average reached 6.11%"; "Freddie Mac 30 Year Fixed (weekly) Mar 12 2026 3/12/26 6.11%"; "averaged 6.11% as of 12 March 2026"
verifications.reasoning: Sources precisely support 6.11% (Freddie Mac) as of March 12, 2026, but provide no support for the 6.29% upper bound of the claimed range; the range is broader than the precise figure given.

verifications.claim: As of March 12, 2026, 30-year fixed-rate mortgage rates saw a slight weekly increase, rising from 6.00%.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "slightly up from the previous week (6.00%)"; "up from 6.00% the previous week"
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly state the rate rose from 6.00% the prior week to 6.11% for the week ending March 12, 2026.

verifications.claim: As of March 12, 2026, 30-year fixed-rate mortgage rates remain lower than the 6.65% average seen during the same period in 2025.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "dip from the 6.65% we saw a year prior"; "6.63% -0.52%"; "down from 6.65% a year ago"
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources confirm the March 12, 2026 rate (6.11%) is lower than the prior year (6.65% or 6.63%).

verifications.claim: Freddie Mac reports the average 30-year rate as 6.11%.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Freddie Mac's Primary Mortgage Market Survey ... the average reached 6.11%"; "Freddie Mac 30 Year Fixed (weekly) Mar 12 2026 3/12/26 6.11%"; "according to Freddie Mac"
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly attribute 6.11% to Freddie Mac for the relevant week.

verifications.claim: Bankrate reports the national average APR as ~6.29%.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "the national average 30-year fixed mortgage APR is 6.55%"; "30 year fixed 6.33%"
verifications.reasoning: Bankrate reference explicitly reports national average APR as 6.55% and interest rate averages around 6.33%-6.49%, directly contradicting the claimed ~6.29%.

verifications.claim: Mortgage News Daily reports the daily survey average as 6.24%.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "MND's 30 Year Fixed (daily survey) Mar 26 2026 3/26/26 6.55%"; "Mar 25 2026 3/25/26 6.48%"; no 6.24% listed
verifications.reasoning: MND references list daily survey averages (e.g., 6.55%, 6.48%, 6.49%) but none match 6.24%, contradicting the claim.

verifications.claim: As of March 12, 2026, 30-year fixed-rate mortgage rates increased weekly from around 6.00% to 6.11%.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "the rate for the week ending March 12, 2026 (6.11%) is slightly up from the previous week (6.00%)"; "up from 6.00% the previous week"
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly confirm weekly increase from 6.00% to 6.11% as of March 12, 2026.

verifications.claim: As of March 12, 2026, 30-year fixed-rate mortgage rates are down from 6.65% a year ago.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "dip from the 6.65% we saw a year prior"; "down from 6.65% a year ago"
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly state the rate is down from 6.65% one year prior.

verifications.claim: As of March 12, 2026, the 15-year fixed rate is averaging 5.50%.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly report 15-year fixed rate as 5.50% for March 12, 2026.
